final: WITH filtered_budget AS (SELECT category, remaining, (amount - spent) as amount_minus_spent FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75), category_stats AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, SUM(amount_minus_spent) as total_amount_minus_spent FROM filtered_budget GROUP BY category), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_amount_minus_spent) as avg_total FROM category_stats) SELECT cs.category, cs.avg_remaining, cs.total_amount_minus_spent, (cs.total_amount_minus_spent - oa.avg_total) as above_average FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE cs.total_amount_minus_spent > oa.avg_total ORDER BY cs.category
